intent_en: To demonstrate that eyewitness misinterpretation is the leading cause of wrongful convictions.
previous_intent: To illustrate that eyewitness misinterpretation is the leading cause of wrongful convictions in the United States.
narration_support: Over 70 % of DNA exonerations in the US have been shown to involve inaccurate eyewitness testimony
chart_support: Bar chart titled 'Causes of wrongful convictions' showing 'Eyewitness misinterpretation' as the highest category, which is circled.
evidence_note: The narration highlights the high rate of inaccurate eyewitness testimony in exonerations, while the chart visually confirms 'Eyewitness misinterpretation' as the top cause of wrongful convictions at 72% (circled), supporting the intent without using specific numbers in the goal statement.
